name: quartz_seq
description: Quartz-seq full-length single-cell RNA-seq. Public data can be plate-like and require sample/well metadata review before automatic mapping.
notes: UniScFlow recognizes Quartz-seq and routes it to download plus documented halt by default. Mapping can be resumed after confirming the sample or well structure.

halt_guidance.blocker: Quartz-seq variants differ in full-length/3-prime behavior and barcode/UMI use; the protocol variant and well identity must be resolved before choosing a mapper.
required_inputs: Quartz-seq protocol version and cell/well-to-sample manifest
Confirmed barcode/UMI status, read pairing, and strandedness
next_steps: Identify the exact Quartz-seq protocol variant from the methods or supplementary files.
Recover the cell/well map and determine whether custom barcode/UMI parsing is required.
Use the explicit STAR-featureCounts target only for confirmed full-length non-UMI inputs; otherwise use the protocol-matched workflow.

recommended_workflows.name: UniScFlow STAR-featureCounts target
recommended_workflows.role: Confirmed full-length non-UMI Quartz-seq after explicit well-map review

halt_guidance.resume: Do not resume from the Quartz-seq name alone; confirm the protocol variant, then use STAR-featureCounts only when full-length non-UMI assumptions hold.
